data.name: Mahek
data.gender_notes: Mahek is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘māheṣā’, meaning ‘great lord’. The name Mahek signifies power, strength, and courage. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name is associated with the goddess Durga, symbolizing her fierce and mighty nature. The name Mahek carries the meaning “Mighty, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahek usually hope their child will grow to embody mighty, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying strength and courage, the name Mahek is a powerful reminder of the inner warrior within each of us.
data.etymology: Mahek belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mighty, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahek total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
